baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural produce noun at word 1 is linked by mimmā to the plural imperfect desire verb at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pleasant produce supplies the material object, while the desiring self supplies the selector; the provision is therefore fitted to its recipients rather than merely displayed before them.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant produce supplies the concrete provision whose fit to the recipients is at issue.
The self's inclination toward a wanted object supplies the selecting relation between appetite and produce.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply adds fruit to a list of blessings.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents provision calibrated to the recipients' own appetitive inclination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun at word 1 carries both produce and delighted-enjoyment branches, and word 3 names active desire.
baseline_models.mechanism: The produce can metonymically name the pleasant ease generated in its enjoyment, so the ayah describes an affective condition as well as available objects.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant ease and delighted enjoyment supply the experiential state produced by the noun.
Inclination toward the desired supplies the inward motion that resolves into delighted ease.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns possession of edible fruit.
changed_reading.after: The verse also concerns the recipients' delighted ease while enjoying what answers their desire.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Plural produce, the partitive relation, and the imperfect plural desire verb leave the desired class open rather than naming one fixed item.
baseline_models.mechanism: The successive-craving branch turns the construction into renewable correspondence: one desired object may be followed by another without exhausting the provision.

activation_trace.role: The plural pleasant produce supplies a repeatable class of concrete satisfactions.
Successive craving and requesting supplies the temporal sequence by which new desired items can arise.

changed_reading.before: A fixed basket of fruit satisfies one appetite.
changed_reading.after: The construction permits an ongoing answer to desire after desire rather than a closed inventory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus provision sits inside a coordinated system of self-protection, shelter, flowing water, and intake without harm; desired produce is nourishment within a safe habitat, not an isolated luxury.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant produce supplies the food component of the habitat.
The self's inclination supplies the appetite that can operate safely inside the habitat.
Averting damage through protection supplies the habitat's defensive function.
Sheltering cover and protection supply the spatial enclosure in which the provision is enjoyed.
A flowing spring supplies the renewable water channel paired with the food.
Ease without hardship or harmful aftereffect supplies the condition of receiving the food.

structural_cues: 77:30-31 offers a three-branched shade that neither shades nor protects from flame; 77:41-43 reverses it with protective shade, springs, desired produce, and unharmed intake.
The focus ayah continues the setting opened in 77:41 and is completed by the eating and drinking imperatives in 77:43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, shelter, spring water, desired produce, and harm-free intake; I infer that they operate as one sustaining ecology. A live alternative is that they are independent rewards in a list.

changed_reading.before: Desired fruit is an isolated item of provision.
changed_reading.after: Desired fruit is the food component of a protected, watered, harm-free habitat, so fulfillment includes secure reception rather than possession alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah gives both groups consumption language, but one meal is corresponding recompense for good action while the other is mere enjoyed benefit explicitly made small; appetite is shared, whereas moral relation and duration sort its outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Delighted enjoyment supplies the positive experiential side of fulfilled appetite.
Inclination toward a wanted object supplies the appetitive capacity shared across the contrast.
Corresponding repayment supplies the relation that makes the focus meal an outcome rather than free-standing consumption.
Doing what is good supplies the action-quality to which the positive meal corresponds.
A benefit enjoyed with pleasure supplies the deliberately similar consumption term on the negative side.
Smallness supplies the hard temporal or quantitative limit placed on the negative enjoyment.

structural_cues: 77:43-44 answers the focus with eating and drinking because of prior work and then names recompense for doers of good.
77:46 repeats eating and enjoyment for the criminals but immediately constrains that enjoyment as little.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies corresponding recompense, good action, pleasurable benefit, and littleness; I infer that duration and moral relation, rather than appetite itself, distinguish the two consumption scenes. An alternative is that littleness names only earthly lifespan and does not qualify the focus enjoyment directly.

changed_reading.before: The focus celebrates appetite itself as the distinguishing good.
changed_reading.after: The focus depicts appetite transformed into enduring, congruent recompense, opposed to brief enjoyment detached from good action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The desiring recipient was created from weak material through stable emplacement and bounded measure; the later matching of provision to desire can therefore be read as creature-provision fit built into an embodied design.

activation_trace.role: The self's inclination supplies the embodied appetite whose origin and fit are being traced.
Bringing a creature into being supplies the originating act behind the later desiring subject.
Weak and lowly material supplies the recipient's unself-sufficient bodily beginning.
Stability and settled placement supply the containing phase of bodily formation.
Enablement and capacity supply the effective security of that formative placement.
A measure by which a thing reaches its bound supplies calibrated development rather than accident.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 forms a causal sequence from weak fluid through secure placement to a known measure and explicit determining.
The same plural audience created in that sequence later appears as the desiring recipients in the focus construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creaturely creation, lowly material, stable enablement, measure, and appetite; I infer that the maker's calibration of the body extends to fitting provision to its desires. A live alternative is that the creation sequence proves power only, without specifying the quality of later desire.

changed_reading.before: Desire is a free-floating preference that happens to be granted.
changed_reading.after: Desire belongs to a measured embodied creature and receives provision fitted to that creaturely design.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ease without harmful aftermath and the stillness of a trusting heart activate an endpoint model in which fulfilled appetite comes to rest, weakening the focus-only reading of indefinitely successive requests.

activation_trace.role: Successive craving supplies the baseline model of desire continually generating another request.
Ease without trouble or unwholesome aftermath supplies a non-restless mode of satisfaction.
The heart settling into security and trust supplies a possible affective endpoint for fulfilled inclination.

structural_cues: 77:43 immediately qualifies consumption after the focus as wholesome and effortless.
77:50 closes the surah by asking about belief, whose cited branch is settled trust rather than proliferating demand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive craving, harmless ease, and heart-rest; I infer a shared movement from inclination to settled satisfaction. The live alternative is that the final belief term concerns assent only and should not govern appetite in 77:42.

changed_reading.before: The focus promises an endless sequence of newly generated wants.
changed_reading.after: Context weakens that model: fulfillment may quiet desire into secure satisfaction rather than perpetuate lack.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence joins pleasant produce to intentional work and then to a non-dominant mapped image of ripeness at harvest-time; recompense can thus be pictured as deeds maturing into edible yield.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant fruit supplies the concrete harvested yield at the focus.
Intentional action supplies what undergoes the inferred process of maturation.
The split-root image of ripeness at cutting time supplies the harvest stage that converts prior work into yield.

structural_cues: 77:42-44 moves without a break from fruit, to eating because of prior work, to the act of recompensing.
The recompense root is split-mapped in the packet, preserving a non-dominant cutting-at-ripeness inventory alongside the dominant repayment inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fruit, intentional work, and a split-mapped harvest-time image; I infer the directional arrow that deeds grow and ripen into provision. The dominant mapped alternative is ordinary corresponding recompense with no agricultural mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Desired fruit is a reward handed over after completed deeds.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the fruit is the ripened harvest of those deeds, making recompense maturation rather than mere transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal gathering is followed by adjudicative separation; the focus phrase then renders the positive outcome as provision fitted to the desires of the separated group, turning personalization into a result of judgment.

activation_trace.role: Each self's inclination toward what it wants supplies the principle of fitted provision after sorting.
Judgment separating right from false supplies the sorting operation that precedes the focus outcome.
Gathering dispersed people into one whole supplies the universal input to that sorting operation.

structural_cues: 77:38 names the Day of Separation and immediately says that the present and earlier peoples have been gathered.
After the challenge and warning refrain in 77:39-40, 77:41-42 identifies the protected group and gives desire-fitted provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal gathering, adjudicative separation, and desire-fitted provision; I infer that judgment particularizes the gathered mass into differentiated outcomes. A live alternative is that the focus describes only a collective class reward, not recipient-level fitting.

changed_reading.before: The provision is merely a generic menu for a blessed group.
changed_reading.after: The provision is the personalized positive issue of a prior gathering-and-separation process.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form is the concrete plural for produce and contains no speech noun. It remains anchored in the root's pleasant-conversation branch and is sharpened by the deniers' speechlessness and the surah's final discourse term. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary convivial resonance, never as the lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-1 root has a branch of pleasant joking and congenial conversation in addition to its produce branch.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant joking and congenial talk supply a social enjoyment latent behind the concrete produce form.
Ordinary speech, explicitly unavailable to the deniers, supplies the reversal against which convivial expression becomes salient.
Renewed report and discourse at the surah's edge keep speech as a live context domain rather than an imported theme.

changed_reading.before: The focus offers desired edible produce only.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, its enjoyment may include restored convivial speech, especially against the deniers' inability to speak.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because the early-milk branch is form-distant from the ordinary fruit noun. It remains anchored in the same focus root and gains a visible before-arrival mechanism from secure gestation and measured development. Downstream prose should mark it as an analogy of antecedent preparation, not claim that the focus noun denotes milk or birth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-1 root includes a branch in which rich milk begins flowing or thickening before birth.

activation_trace.role: Rich provision developing before birth supplies the material image of readiness preceding the recipient's arrival.
A place of coming-to-be supplies the gestational setting in which recipient and provision can be coordinated in advance.
Development to an appointed measure supplies the timing by which readiness precedes emergence.

changed_reading.before: Provision reacts to a desire only after the recipient voices or feels it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, desired provision is already maturing before arrival, as part of measured preparation for the recipient.

strongest_changes: The false-shade and true-shade scenes turn desired produce into one component of a protected, watered, harm-free ecology.
The paired consumption commands distinguish fulfilled desire from brief enjoyment through deed, recompense, and duration rather than through appetite alone.
Measured creation and judicial separation recast what is desired as fitted provision for embodied recipients after sorting.
The split mapping of the recompense root preserves an exploratory harvest mechanism in which deeds ripen into fruit.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made repetition do the main work: shade, eating, temporality, creation, gathering, and separation changed the focus from a static fruit list into several causal models of protected, calibrated, and morally differentiated fulfillment. The non-dominant split-root harvest image and the focus root's conversation and pre-birth-milk branches remained visible as contained discoveries.
remaining_uncertainties: The pleasant-conversation and pre-birth-milk branches may be too form-distant for anything beyond explicitly marked resonance or analogy.
The creation-and-measure sequence may establish divine power without implying that every appetite is calibrated by design.
The final heart-rest branch of belief may not semantically govern desire, so successive and quieted fulfillment remain live competitors.
The focus plural may promise class-level abundance rather than recipient-by-recipient personalization after judgment.
